source: the peer node is a SOCKS proxy that demands proxyAuthentication credentials; a forward through forwardSocksProxy with forwardProxyAuthenticationUsername/Password offers NO_AUTH and PASSWORD (Netty's Socks5ProxyHandler), and a MockServer proxy picks NO_AUTH whenever it is offered, so the credentials are never sent to it (a wrong password goes through alike)

steps.note: the proxy's startup entries are not the point
the SOCKS proxy lets it through
a target that does not resolve here is left to the proxy, which is sent its name
